summary.text: Customers praise the mixer grinder's powerful 750W motor and effective blade design, while appreciating its compact size that suits smaller kitchens. However, the performance receives mixed feedback - while some say it performs well, others report it stops working within a month. Moreover, durability is a concern as customers report jars breaking within months of use. Additionally, the noise level is high, and several customers mention missing parts, particularly the rubber gasket of the jar.

authors_reviews.title: Powerful performance and very compact
authors_reviews.text: I’ve been using this Philips HL7756 mixer for a few days now, and it is performing quite well. The 750-watt motor has a lot of punch. I tried dry grinding whole spices and making thick batter, and it handled both quickly without heating up much.​The 3 stainless steel jars are of good quality, feel sturdy, and the blade design is effective. The lids fit tightly, so there are no leakage issues so far. Because of the compact design, it doesn't take up too much space on the kitchen counter.​Just a couple of practical observations: It is quite loud, but that’s standard for any 750W mixer grinder. Also, you might notice a slight burning smell when you turn it on the very first time—don't worry, that's just the new motor varnish heating up and it goes away completely after a couple of uses.Overall, it's a solid, value-for-money product for daily cooking.

authors_reviews.title: **No stars. Extremely disappointing customer service from Amazon.**
authors_reviews.text: **No stars. Extremely disappointing customer service.**It's very disappointing to receive this level of customer service from such a well-known global brand through Amazon.We ordered this product but, after using it, realized that the jar size was not suitable for our family's needs. We contacted customer support hoping to exchange it for the same product with a larger jar. However, we were repeatedly told that the item is non-returnable and that replacements are only provided if the product is damaged.Our request was genuine—we were not asking for a refund, only an exchange for a more suitable model. Unfortunately, the customer service team simply kept repeating the policy without making any effort to help or explore a possible solution.Another disappointing aspect was the mention of "Open Box Delivery." We had not selected any Open Box Delivery option while placing the order. When I asked the customer service agent how customers can opt out of Open Box Delivery during checkout for future purchases, the agent simply stated that it is possible but was unable to explain where this option is available or how to access it. I was asking for future reference, yet the agent could not provide a clear answer.We have lived in the UK and the USA and have never faced such difficulty with returns or exchanges from this brand. The customer-focused approach we experienced there is completely different. The policy in India feels unnecessarily rigid, especially when an honest customer is requesting a reasonable replacement rather than trying to misuse the system.I expected much better customer support from a global brand. Instead of simply repeating the policy, the support team should be empowered to guide customers, answer their questions accurately, and make reasonable efforts to resolve genuine concerns. A little flexibility and a willingness to assist honest customers would have made all the difference.
authors_reviews.author: Tarun

authors_reviews.title: Philips Mixer Grinder: The Perfect Companion for Every Kitchen
authors_reviews.text: I recently acquired the Philips Mixer Grinder, and I must say, it has quickly become an indispensable part of my kitchen. This product has surpassed my expectations in every way, from its sturdy build and powerful motor to its sleek and shiny design. Without a doubt, this mixer grinder deserves a resounding five-star rating.One of the standout features of this Philips Mixer Grinder is its sturdy body. The robust construction instills confidence and ensures that the appliance can withstand the rigors of daily use. It feels solid and durable, providing assurance that it will last for a long time. I appreciate the attention to detail in crafting a mixer grinder that can handle heavy loads and frequent grinding without compromising on performance.Speaking of performance, the motor of this mixer grinder is exceptional. It operates with remarkable efficiency, delivering consistent power to effortlessly handle various tasks. Whether it's grinding tough ingredients or blending smooth purees, this mixer grinder tackles every job with ease. I am impressed by its ability to grind even the hardest spices to a fine powder, achieving the desired texture and consistency every time.The shiny body of the Philips Mixer Grinder adds a touch of elegance to my kitchen countertop. The polished finish not only enhances its visual appeal but also makes it easy to clean and maintain. It exudes a premium feel and complements the overall aesthetics of my kitchen. It's a pleasure to have a functional appliance that also adds a touch of sophistication to the culinary space.Furthermore, the mixer grinder comes with an appropriate number of jars to cater to every kitchen need. The different-sized jars are well-designed and perfect for various tasks, including grinding, blending, and juicing. The versatility offered by these jars makes this appliance an all-in-one solution for a wide range of culinary requirements.In conclusion, the Philips Mixer Grinder has exceeded my expectations and has become an essential part of my kitchen routine. Its sturdy body, powerful motor, and sleek design make it an ideal choice for every household. I am thoroughly satisfied with its performance and gladly award it a well-deserved five-star rating.For anyone seeking a reliable and efficient mixer grinder that combines durability, power, and aesthetic appeal, I wholeheartedly recommend the Philips Mixer Grinder. It is a valuable addition to any kitchen and will undoubtedly enhance your cooking experience.
